Question 13
?

If A={4,8,…,80}, which collection of subsets of A is a partition of A?

a
{{2,4,…,20},{22,24,…,58},{60,62,…,80}}
b
{{4,8,20},{24,28,…,80}}
c
{{4,8,…,20},{24,28,32,36},{40,44,…,56},{60,64,…,80}}
d
{{4,6,…,20},{24,26,…,80}}
e
{{4,8,…,20},{60,64,…,80}}
Submit
